description: Drum loop through the real Scratch Cat FX C++ engine. The deck is grabbed at 2.0 s, released, and braked 0.25 s later like a turntable stop; the sound goes live again at 4.6 s. No level change is applied: the plugin passes the sound bit exact until the deck is grabbed (checked: identical to the Before clip up to the grab and again after going live).
